en.sayed-ali-raza: Besides that, we also have the distinction of prophethood among us, by virtue of which we subdued the strong and raised up the down-trodden.

When Allāh made Arabia enter (the fold of) His religion, and the people submitted to it willingly or unwillingly, you were among those who entered the religion either from greed or from fear, at a time when those who had gone first had preceded and the first muhājirūn had acquired their (peculiar) distinction.
